scope: Public official Earth Engine STAC catalog collection metadata and the previously reviewed 363 community documentation families. No authenticated Earth Engine calls, exports, dataset downloads or publication.
metric: Maximum OpenAlex cited_by_count among reviewed associated dataset papers, never a sum. Data-release DOI citations are separate. Unknown never becomes zero.
reference_policy: Review references without citation counts; use recommended catalog citations and primary producer sources.
Separate data papers and product-specific methods from generic algorithms, background references, applications, platform papers and data-release DOIs.
Label broader family papers used for derived products or versions as base_dataset_family. A paper count never proves use of an exact GEE release.
A title-only match requires identity evidence; ambiguous or unmatched references remain unresolved.
Use corpus=all for work-list lookups and preserve actual request parameters, UTC timestamps and responses.
population_policy: Each current official STAC Collection is one entry, including deprecated versions; emit active-only and global-only views.
The community population remains the pinned 363 documentation families. Refresh counts in this separate snapshot without altering the original study.
Publish entry-level rankings plus shared-paper groups. Grouping by paper is a presentation aid, not a claim of dataset equivalence.
Shared asset references are overlap candidates, not sufficient evidence for equivalent primary products.
Geographic scope is classified from catalog descriptions and bounds before counts: global, regional, mixed, unclear. Store region notes.
validation_before_results: Every discovered collection must have one normalized entry and one reference/scope review, with any crawl errors preventing a complete-inventory claim.
All counted paper identities must be reviewed; no works typed dataset may enter paper rankings.
One observed work ID has one count across official and community views in this snapshot. Counts must be nonnegative integers; missing/API errors remain null.
Duplicate paper references never increase scores; paper/data counts never sum; ties use stable entry IDs.
Test complex DOI parsing including parentheses, angle brackets and Markdown escaping; role exclusions, unknown-versus-zero, global filters and non-equivalence of shared papers.
Offline rebuild must byte-match committed JSON/CSV outputs; original community files and canonical dataset records remain unchanged.
Review leading shared-paper groups against primary source/catalog metadata and report coverage and unresolved titles rather than claim universal top ten.

cost_guardrails.openalex_auth: Public no-key allowance only; stop on budget response. No account creation or paid requests.

limitations: Citation totals favor older publications and do not measure current quality, exact-release usage, cloud-native availability or conversion need.
Official collection entries and community documentation families have different granularity.
Unresolved references can change the leading order; results rank resolved reviewed references only.
A fresh cloud-host/registry/licensing audit remains a separate step before choosing conversions.
